close_reason: Fixed in d3adb1f: SpaceJoinInput has manual Debug impl that redacts the InviteCode variant payload. SpaceId variant still renders verbatim. Two regression tests (one negative, one positive) confirm variant-scoped redaction.
description:
Location: `crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:702-709`

  #[non_exhaustive]
  #[derive(Debug)]
  pub enum SpaceJoinInput<'a> {
      InviteCode(&'a str),   // <-- secret credential
      SpaceId(&'a Id),
  }

CONCERN
The `InviteCode` variant wraps the same unguessable secret as `SpaceInvite.code` (see sibling bead). This is the caller-facing client API for the `Space/join` method call — every consumer constructs this enum to pass a code.

Any `{:?}`-format of a SpaceJoinInput value leaks the code:
- Application-layer logging at the SDK boundary
- Test fixtures or examples that Debug-print arguments
- Future tracing instrumentation on the client surface

Direct analogue of JMAP-sc1b.79 (BearerAuth/BasicAuth Debug redaction) applied to a different secret-bearing public type — got missed by that pass.

WHAT GOES WRONG
Confidentiality / key recovery — the invite-link token is leaked through any Debug-format path on the client side, before it ever crosses the wire.

PROPOSED FIX
1. Remove `Debug` from the derive list at line 703.
2. Add a manual Debug impl that prints `SpaceJoinInput::InviteCode` as `InviteCode([REDACTED])` and `SpaceJoinInput::SpaceId(id)` verbatim (Id is not a secret per RFC 8620 §1.2).
3. Add a regression test that constructs SpaceJoinInput::InviteCode with a canary string and asserts the canary does not appear in `{:?}` output.

ORACLE
- Canonical: JMAP-sc1b.79 fix for BearerAuth/BasicAuth in auth.rs:183-189 + test at auth.rs:443-475.
- ChatBackend trait doc-comment at `crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs:74-89` defines the code field as a credential.

RISK CLASSIFICATION
P2. Live confidentiality defect on the canonical client-side API for Space/join. The Chat client is canonical for the JMAP Chat client family per AGENTS.md propagation rules — fix here, no other sibling has the same shape yet.
title: Security: SpaceJoinInput::InviteCode derives Debug exposing the invite-code secret (crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:702)
